newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schenker says has 3 pct of air cargo market.
newsitem.headline: Schenker says has 3 pct of air cargo market.

text.p: Global freight forwarder Schenker International said it has a 3.1 percent share of the world air cargo market based on IATA and company figures.
Schenker International (SI) said it was the second-largest forwarder worldwide in 1995 with 480,000 tonnes of airfreight and turnover with airlines of $743 million.
SI aimed to extend its market position by improving its productivity, service and quality, a statement from parent company Schenker-Rhenus AG said.
Airfreight director Klaus Geissler told a recent airfreight managers meeting in South Africa the number two position as merely a stepping-stone towards long-term aims, according to the statement.

"The race of the biggest forwarders will be won by the one who is able to serve his client best, which means delivering on time, being reliable and creating a minimum of work for the client, and by the one who at the same time succeeds in increasing his level of value," he said.
Schenker International is the air and sea freight forwarding division of Schenker-Rhenus, which is part of the Stinnes trading group. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
